en.headline: Power bank smokes on Island Line train near Quarry Bay; no injuries
en.dek: A passenger’s portable charger began emitting smoke on a Kennedy Town-bound train after Tai Koo on Sunday night; firefighters found it already out and MTR service was not disrupted.
body: A portable charger carried by a passenger started smoking inside an Island Line train compartment on Sunday evening as the service headed towards Kennedy Town after leaving Tai Koo, local media reported, citing police and fire records. Smoke filled part of the carriage and some passengers covered their noses and moved towards the doors.

Police received a report at about 9.14pm. When the train reached Quarry Bay station, MTR staff boarded and moved the device onto the platform. Firefighters who attended found the charger no longer smoking and extinguished any remaining hazard. The Fire Services Department said nobody was injured and no station evacuation was required.

MTR services on the Island Line continued without a reported suspension. Witnesses described a brief scramble in the crowded car as people tried to get away from the smell and haze. Officers have not released the brand of the device or said whether a formal investigation beyond the on-site response will follow.

zh.headline: 港島絲列車充電器冒煙 鰌魚涌站處理無人傷
zh.dek: 週日晚上往堅尼地城方向列車離開太古後，有乘客便攜式充電器冒煙；消防員到場時已無煙，港鐵服務未受影響。
body: 週日晚上約9時14分，港島絲一班往堅尼地城方向列車離開太古站後，車廂內一名乘客的便攜式充電器突然冒煙，車廂一度煙霧彌漫，部分乘客捅鼻並走向車門。警方接報後，列車抵達鰌魚涌站，港鐵職員登車將充電器移至月台處理。
消防到場時充電器已沒有再冒煙，並將餘火救熄。消防處表示事件中無人受傷，亦毋須疏散車站。港鐵港島絲服務未有因此暫停。
現場片段顯示部分乘客匆忙走避。港鐵及警方未有公布涉事充電器牌子，亦未說明會否作進一步調查。
